title: Boundary subobject under the normalized row cycle comparison
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and $\mathcal B$ a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive [def-sp-left-exact-additive], and let $I$ be a commuting bicomplex with complex degree in $\mathbf Z$ and resolution degree in $\mathbf N$ [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Put $R_s=F(I.X(s))$, $J=\operatorname{flip}(\operatorname{mappedFunctor}(F)(I))$ [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation], and $K=\operatorname{Tot}(J)$. Let $L$ be a decreasing filtration of $K$ by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration] such that its degreewise steps equal the second filtration of $J$. Fix $r\in\mathbf N$, $s\in\mathbf Z$, and $n=s+r$. Write $a_{r,s}:R_s^r\to K^n$ for the inverse of the extension-by-zero isomorphism followed by the $(r,s)$ diagonal coprojection. Let $t:\operatorname{cycles}^r(R_s)\to (L^sK)^n$ satisfy $t m=i_{\mathrm{cycles}}a_{r,s}$, where $m$ is the filtration inclusion. Put $Z=L.\mathrm{complexCycles}(s,n,1)$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], and let $q:(L^sK)^n\to (\operatorname{gr}^s L)^n$ be the graded projection. Suppose $c:\operatorname{cycles}^r(R_s)\cong Z$ satisfies $c\,\iota_Z=tq$. Let $b:L.\mathrm{complexBoundaries}(s,n,1)\to Z$ be the canonical inclusion [lem-sp-filtered-complex-boundaries-le-cycles]. Then $c^*(\operatorname{im}b)=\operatorname{im}(R_s.\mathrm{toCycles}(\operatorname{prev}(r),r))$, as subobjects of $\operatorname{cycles}^r(R_s)$. Here $\operatorname{prev}$ is the predecessor function for the shape $\operatorname{up}\mathbf N$; in particular $\operatorname{prev}(0)=0$.

proof.text: Construct the target row-term lift a through the filtration step. The distinguished diagonal image is a summand of the finite supremum over [s,s+r], so image(row inclusion) lies in L.complexStep s (s+r). Factor through the step mono. The normalization ht and monicity give row.iCycles followed by a equal to the prescribed t.

Apply the already-proved first-page boundary formula. If r=0, the interval [s,s-1] is empty, hence L.complexStep s (s-1) is bottom. The monic step inclusion is zero, so its source is zero. The graded projection is epic, hence the incoming graded source is zero. The row toCycles(prev 0,0) is zero by cancellation of iCycles and the shape equation d(0,0)=0. Thus both ambient boundary images are bottom.

For r>0 use the incoming row cover e and its differential square. Precomposition by the epic e leaves the image unchanged. Replace row.d by row.toCycles followed by row.iCycles, use row.iCycles followed by a equal to t, and use hc. The first-page boundary formula therefore gives complexBoundaries equal to image(row.toCycles followed by c.hom and the cycle arrow).

Map the image of the canonical boundary-to-cycle inclusion into the ambient graded term along the cycle mono. Its composite with that mono is the boundary arrow, whose image is the boundary subobject. Mapping the row boundary image along c.hom and then the cycle mono gives the same ambient image by the preceding calculation. Injectivity of subobject map along the cycle mono identifies these two subobjects of cycles. Pulling back along c.hom cancels its subobject map, giving the asserted equality.
